page.overview:
What is Ends of Grymoire?

The Ends of Grymoire is an area located in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is a portion of chain that connects from The Chainroad to Castle Exnine. It is first visited in Chapter 21, "Chaos in Grymoire".

Located at the westernmost end of the chain. Touching the Touch Pad takes the player inside the castle itself.

Located at the easternmost end of the chain, accessed by touching the Touch Pad.
